decisions.decision: Claude takes this over from Nelbin. Open Claude in Chrome on profile 'Browser 2', which memory records as already signed in to boards@fintechcircle.com. Go to https://script.google.com/home and check the account avatar shows boards@. Trash ONLY the two projects named 'Tantra funnel forms receiver'. Look in My Projects, and look for the copy bound to the Work Tracker. That bound copy is attached to the sheet adi@growthclub.org owns, so leave it and note it on the task if it can't be trashed from boards@. Never open or change 'Tantra Funnel' under adi@growthclub.org, and touch no other boards@ project. Afterwards, reload the list and take a screenshot as evidence. Check the live receiver's health URL still lists all six forms. Write the revert-ledger entry, then move the task to review. If Browser 2 is signed out or offline, hand it back to Nelbin with the URL. Don't escalate this to Adi.

Removing our own leftovers is the revert that vendor-accounts-no-change-rule requires. O-75c84b8c on T-107 already approved the trash step. No credential or new sign-in is needed.
